Krugersdorp Killers Finale

By: Kate Barry | Paid

Proposal


Show:

One Liner (Tonight on Carte Blanche...):
The verdict in the year-long murder trial of the Krugersdorp Killers

Unique Selling Point:
Exclusive interview with SAPS investigating officer, Captain Ben Booysen.
Exclusive interview with Hannelie Scheepers, the step-mother who convinced Marcell Steyn to confess the truth.
Exclusive interviews with the families of the victims.
Crime scene photos

Summary:
After a year in Court, the Krugersdorp Killers trial draws to a close. We summarise the crimes, families of victims detail how the nightmare unfolded through first hand accounts and crime scene photos. Captain Ben Booysen takes us through his investigation and reveals how he managed to crack the case and link the Appointment Murders to 7 previous murders.

Further information:
In a stunning turnaround, Marcell Steyn took the stand after a 6-month break and confessed to her involvement in and knowledge of all the murders, the bomb throwing, the intimidation and the unlawful possession of arms and ammunition. She also implicated Cecilia Steyn, confirming that she was the leader of the Ministry and the mastermind behind all the crimes.
Her stepmother had visited her in Prison over December and convinced her to tell the truth.

Extra Budget Items:
Extra long duration 2 x 8' as agreed by Wynand. This will allow for extra shoot days.

Press Release:


Judgement Day: Krugersdorp Killers Convicted
Guilty as charged – in what the judge called a religious scam, manipulation and deadly deceit convinced a Krugersdorp mother and her teenaged children they were killing for God. In a Carte Blanche exclusive we meet the investigating officer who cracked the case of the notorious Krugersdorp Killers. Together with the seasoned detective we revisit the crime scenes, examine the forensics and find out how he secured the six convictions that were handed down by Judge Francis in the Gauteng High Court this week. In a television first, we also bring you never-before-seen footage of the arrests, and finally speak to victims’ families who have waited more than three years for justice.
Producer: Kate Barry
Presenter: Derek Watts


Script:


KK FINALE

Judge: Based on the evidence placed before me I am satisfied that the accused are found guilty on the following charges: Count 1 – all three accused are found guilty of Count 1.

V/O: Last week the remaining Krugersdorp Killers - Zak Valentine, Cecilia Steyn and Marcel Steyn - were convicted of murder, robbery, fraud, intimidation, causing an explosion, malicious damage to property, illegal possession of firearms and ammunition and racketeering.

Judge: And on Count 32, all three accused are found guilty of Count 32.

V/O: Calling themselves Electus Per Deus, or chosen by God, this gang included convicted murderers Leroux Steyn, his mother Marinda Steyn and John Barnard. Together they killed 11 people, at the behest of mastermind Cecilia Steyn. Although she didn’t physically commit any murders, she was the puppet master.

Link: Even though all 6 killers have been convicted, there are still people in hiding; people whose lives were shattered by these events. Like Ria Grunewald, and although Ria testified in Court, we cannot show her face.

V/O: Originally, they all belonged to Ria’s Christian ministry Overcomers Through Christ. She lived in Drimar Court, only a block away from where Cecilia lived in Cosanna Flats. Cecilia convinced Ria, that having left the Satanic Church, she was now in constant need of prayers and protection. Ria believed every word she said.

Ria: I did whatever I could. Whenever she needed me, I raced off to her, I rushed off to her, to just go and see if I could pray for her or help her.

Link: At the group’s so-called “high nights” in this little corner of Hell, all attention was focused on Cecilia as she claimed to be under attack by demons. This was probably the height of her deceit and manipulation.

Sfx: “Recover in Jesus name. In Jesus name recover. No, no, we pull her out!”

V/O: Believing the Satanic Church was trying to steal her spirit, the group prayed fervently for her deliverance while Cecilia writhed about on the floor. To add credence to this scary scenario, she would start coughing blood. But it was all a charade, according to a former friend.

Sfx: No, no!

Candice: She would take a surgical glove and she would cut the finger pieces off those gloves. She would then tie a strap around her arm and then she would draw her blood from a syringe. She would then take one of those finger pieces and fill it with blood, put it into her mouth, twist it to make a knot, and she did that for each one.

V/O: In 2012, when Ria finally realized that Cecilia was lying, she ended the relationship, and it was this split that triggered the crime spree. In their first act of revenge they threw home-made explosives at the Overcomers cars parked outside a prayer meeting, and petrol-bombed the Lighthouse Full Gospel Church.

Ria: When the bombs went off, I realized that I had to break away. I knew no matter if the Satanic Church kills her or takes her back into the Satanic Church I can’t be there anymore. At that stage I thought I cannot put other people’s lives in danger.
She said to me well, if you think the bombs were something what’s coming now is worse. And she said to me now people are gonna pay with their lives.

V/O: The next day, Natasha Burger and Joy Boonzaier were stabbed to death by Zak Valentine and his wife Mikeila.

A week later, Ria’s mentor Pastor Reg Bendixen was hit over the head with an axe and stabbed to death.

When Mikeila Valentine tried to leave the group, she was stabbed over 60 times as she lay sleeping.

In November 2015 John Barnard’s employers Peter and Joan Meyer were stabbed to death in their home.

Two weeks later Jarod Jackson was strangled and burned to death in Zak’s car, in an attempted life insurance fraud.

In January 2016 tax consultant Glen McGregor was shot and strangled and his body dumped in the bath.

In the so-called Appointment Murders, insurance broker Anthony Scholefield was strangled in Marinda’s flat and his body found in the boot of his abandoned car.

Weeks later another insurance broker Kevin McAlpine met the same fate. Their stolen bank cards were used at an ABSA ATM.

Finally, the body of estate agent Hanle Lategan was found dumped in the veld near Randfontein.

Ben: She was just dragged out of the car and was thrown here with the one shoe. The other shoe was not found with the body. People don’t even treat their animals like this. These people are worse than animals.

V/O: Captain Ben Booysen, a seasoned investigator from the Hawks, was called in to take over the investigation.

Ben: Hanle Lategan stayed about 500 meters from my home address, and I was a cop in Krugersdorp for a long time.

V/O: Ben was deployed by Brigadier Manie Victor, the Head of the police War Room who’d established a task team.

Manie: The real breakthrough came when an informer said that the footage that we at that time got from the different ATMs, the footage seems to be those of Marinda Steyn's children - Leroux and Marcel. They were not on our radar. None whatsoever. We brought in the two Steyn children. They came voluntarily and that assisted us in taking photos, doing the facial comparison which came out perfect matches. Both Marcel and Leroux.

V/O: Then 18, Marcel and 20-year-old Leroux were arrested on charges of murder. Leroux made a false confession claiming to have acted alone. But Ben soon made headway.

Link: This is Jan de Klerk High School where Marinda Steyn taught English. It was an anonymous tip-off that led Ben to search the home economics classroom. There he made a discovery that resulted in a major breakthrough.

V/O: Ben discovered hundreds of rounds of ammunition hidden in two stoves. The Headmaster then told him that Marinda had recently asked him to witness a Will, in which she made Cecilia her sole beneficiary. Ben showed the Will to Leroux in Krugersdorp Prison.

Ben: And I said read: see how much your mother loved you. And then he read that the mother disowned him and his sister, and tears was coming down his cheek and the side of his lip started doing this and then I knew. Now I've got him. And then he said "Fok haar nou", and then he started speaking to me.

V/O: Leroux gave a full confession about all their crimes dating back to 2012, including all 11 murders. The Task Team received information that Zak Valentine was still alive, and he too was arrested. After some investigation, Cecilia and Marinda were then arrested at Cosanna Flats and taken into custody at Krugersdorp Police Station. John Barnard made a full confession after evidence placed him at the scene of several murders, including the home of Glen McGregor.

Ben: I did a 205 on everybody’s phones that was involved in the killings, and John Barnard was the only person that when they went to a crime scene, and he was with, he took his phone. So if you looked at their phones, they were still at 17 Cosanna Flats, but his phone was here.

V/O: At 17 Cosanna Flats Ben found irrefutable evidence that this was the scene of the appointment murders.

Ben: There was a wall unit here, there was this little piece of carpet here, and the bed was standing there.

V/O: Noticing stains on the carpet, he arranged for the BlueStar forensic test.

Ben: Even though the carpet was washed twice, we still found blood on the carpet, on the underfelt and on the cement, and that blood was Scholefield’s and Leroux’s. So it seems to me that Leroux and Scholefield were in a battle here, because Leroux’s blood was also found here.

V/O: Leroux also told Ben about a false compartment he’d constructed in his bedroom at flat number 17. That’s where he stashed the gangs large firearms, The police recovered a variety of weapons, including a semi-automatic rifle, and a shotgun. But firearms were also cunningly concealed behind the building.

Ben: They used fishing line, put it on the gutter. Then on that fishing line there was a blue rope, but you can’t see the blue rope. Then on that rope there was a bag, and in that bag was all the hand weapons that they hide between two walls. So, even if you walk past there, you look up you will not be able to see the fishing line because, you must look for it actually to see it.

V/O: Within 3 weeks of Ben taking over the investigation, all the Krugersdorp Killers had been arrested.

Ben: When I asked Leroux when would you stop killing people? And he told me straight in prison, they wouldn’t have stopped because it was easy money and they got away with so many murders already that they wouldn’t have stopped until they have been arrested.

Link: From Day1the details of this trial have been shocking beyond belief. But just when you thought it couldn’t get any more dramatic, the Court was rocked by new evidence. After a 6-month recess, Marcel Steyn took the stand and delivered what can only be described as a bomb.

Marcel: Not guilty on both Counts, Your Honour.

V/O: Having originally pleaded Not Guilty to all charges, Marcel now admitted her involvement in the crimes, including all the murders.

Marcel: Cecilia had said that it’s war. So, she said you know, in times of war things work differently and she used David as an example. She said that David killed a lot of people, sometimes even the wives and the children and the livestock because God instructed him to. And she said that God had instructed her that this is what we must do.

V/O: Now 21, she was only 14 years-old when she watched her mother and Zak kill Pastor Reg Bendixen.

Marcel: Then I saw then that he was already on the ground.

Sharon: Yes?

Marcel: And my mom was stabbing him.

Sharon: Yes, what did you do then?

Marcel: I froze. I just stared at them. I could not stop looking at them.

V/O: She then described how she’d been taken to Zak’s house during the school holidays, to help her mother kill Mikaela Valentine.

Marcel: I stood there and I was looking at my mother stab her, and I was thinking that you know if we go back to Cecilia an my mother tells her that I froze, that she is going to ridicule me, and say you know I am supposed to be the one with the psychopath demons, how could I freeze? So I went in and I had my own knife, and I stabbed her in her left side and then I just could not do more than that. So I told my mother my knife is blunt, you know it is not working, and she said it is okay, she is going to finish up now anyway, and I retreated to the door again and I waited for her to finish.

V/O: Marcel also admitted to being present when Peter and Joan Meyer were killed in their home in November 2015.

Ben: The father was laying here and the mother was laying here. It was just blood everywhere.

Marcel: Zack just started stabbing them. I think he stabbed Joan Meyer first, and at that point Peter Meyer started reciting Psalm 23. And he started stabbing and then he moved back and forth between the two of them.

Ben: You know, I took the cases over a long time after the killing, so I only saw the photos. but sawing the photos and listening to the people testifying, there’s a picture in my mind that is difficult to get out.

Derek: You can’t get rid of it?

Ben: No, you can’t get rid of it.

V/O: The Meyers were killed while Marcel was writing matric, which she passed with 6 distinctions.

Link: With all the sensational revelations of this trial, the brazen and dramatic killings, it’s easy to focus on the perpetrators. We forget that behind each victim is a family that has been completely devastated.

V/O: Kezia McAlpine was 7 months pregnant when her husband Kevin didn’t return from his 6 o’ clock appointment.

Kezia: And eventually someone said we found the car and there’s a body in the boot, and we’re not sure if it’s your husband or not?

Derek: How did you feel right then?

Kezia: I think I just immediately started praying and going please let it not be him. I'm sure it’s not him, it’s was just a mistake. It has to be somebody else. And then they asked if I could send them a picture of him so that they could identify whether it was him or not in the boot. And I remember at one point I just went and sort of hid behind the couch and thought if nobody can tell me, then it can’t be him. I think they were scared because I was pregnant, and what would happen if they did tell me that it was him. So they were waiting for the ambulance to get there, the paramedics, and I could hear on the phone, and you know when a phone call is rather loud, him saying to the man on the other side - it is him.

V/O: Now the Manager of Cradle of Hope, Candice Ellison and her partner Jared Jackson were recovering addicts in 2015. They sold sweets and chips near Cosanna Flats, and they were befriended by Cecilia and the group. When Zak decided to fake his own death and claim millions in life insurance, it was Jarod who was strangled and burned in his place.

Candice: Initially all I knew was that Jarod didn't come home and I tried to contact Celia and find out what's going on with Jarod, are Jarod and Zak okay? And when I eventually went to Cecilia's flat she told me no, that Jarod had not gone with Zak but that Zak had been in a car accident and was in a coma. And I asked where Jarod was, and she said she did not know. Jared left and walked away that night.

V/O: Candice gave birth to their daughter just 3 weeks after Jarod disappeared, but only found out months later what had happened to him.

Candice: That was one of the most traumatic moments, because I’d had months of self-doubt that Jared ran away. Did he commit suicide? Did he get scared, did he meet another woman? Was he wandering in the streets somewhere, had he been hurt? And at that moment all of that just came home and absolutely destroyed me.

V/O: Lorna McGregor’s brother Glen was shot, strangled and placed in a bath of hot water after the group stole R6000 out of his bank account.

Lorna: He must have still been alive. He wasn’t dead. He wasn’t dead…so I mean, how do you put someone through so much pain? It’s terrible, it’s absolutely terrible! Not even for just Glen, listening to Glen’s thing, but to sit and listen to each and – what they did to each and every family’s member.

Marcel: l’m very sorry. I know that me testifying and telling the truth and admitting what I had done and how sorry I am does not bring them back. And I realized that it does not take the pain away and that you are going to walk with that for the rest of your life and I contributed to that. And all I can say is I’m sorry. I am really sorry.

Link: Now that all three accused have been convicted, they await sentencing. But what is an appropriate sentence for Marcel who was only 14 when the first murders were committed? Will the State seek the maximum – 11 life sentences – or will Judge Francis be lenient?

Lorna: Is there an actual sentence you can give them for what they’ve done - the hurt , the pain they’ve put us all through? There is no sentence actually, even if they had to get a hundred years. Is it going to take our pain away, is it going to give us that peace? No, it’s not.

Kezia: I think I’ve come to realize that no matter what happens there, it doesn’t change things for me. It doesn’t bring Daniel’s dad back. It doesn’t bring my husband back. But I feel like they should probably never get out of prison.

Candice: I know they’re going to get the sentence they deserve, and ultimately, the only appropriate sentence can be dished out by God.

Ben: These people need to be punished on another level, because they’re evil. They’re evil.

And she said to me now people are gonna pay with their lives. V/O: The next day, Natasha Burger and Joy Boonzaier were stabbed to death by Zak Valentine and his wife Mikeila. A week later, Ria’s mentor Pastor Reg Bendixen was hit over the head with an axe and stabbed to death. When Mikeila Valentine tried to leave the group, she was stabbed over 60 times as she lay sleeping. In November 2015 John Barnard’s employers Peter and Joan Meyer were stabbed to death in their home. Two weeks later Jarod Jackson was strangled and burned to death in Zak’s car, in an attempted life insurance fraud. In January 2016 tax consultant Glen McGregor was shot and strangled and his body dumped in the bath. In the so-called Appointment Murders, insurance broker Anthony Scholefield was strangled in Marinda’s flat and his body found in the boot of his abandoned car. Weeks later another insurance broker Kevin McAlpine met the same fate. Their stolen bank cards were used at an ABSA ATM. Finally, the body of estate agent Hanle Lategan was found dumped in the veld near Randfontein. Ben: She was just dragged out of the car and was thrown here with the one shoe. The other shoe was not found with the body. People don’t even treat their animals like this. These people are worse than animals. V/O: Captain Ben Booysen, a seasoned investigator from the Hawks, was called in to take over the investigation. Ben: Hanle Lategan stayed about 500 meters from my home address, and I was a cop in Krugersdorp for a long time. V/O: Ben was deployed by Brigadier Manie Victor, the Head of the police War Room who’d established a task team. Manie: The real breakthrough came when an informer said that the footage that we at that time got from the different ATMs, the footage seems to be those of Marinda Steyn's children - Leroux and Marcel. They were not on our radar. None whatsoever. We brought in the two Steyn children. They came voluntarily and that assisted us in taking photos, doing the facial comparison which came out perfect matches. Both Marcel and Leroux. V/O: Then 18, Marcel and 20-year-old Leroux were arrested on charges of murder. Leroux made a false confession claiming to have acted alone. But Ben soon made headway. Link: This is Jan de Klerk High School where Marinda Steyn taught English. It was an anonymous tip-off that led Ben to search the home economics classroom. There he made a discovery that resulted in a major breakthrough. V/O: Ben discovered hundreds of rounds of ammunition hidden in two stoves. The Headmaster then told him that Marinda had recently asked him to witness a Will, in which she made Cecilia her sole beneficiary. Ben showed the Will to Leroux in Krugersdorp Prison. Ben: And I said read: see how much your mother loved you. And then he read that the mother disowned him and his sister, and tears was coming down his cheek and the side of his lip started doing this and then I knew. Now I've got him. And then he said "Fok haar nou", and then he started speaking to me. V/O: Leroux gave a full confession about all their crimes dating back to 2012, including all 11 murders. The Task Team received information that Zak Valentine was still alive, and he too was arrested. After some investigation, Cecilia and Marinda were then arrested at Cosanna Flats and taken into custody at Krugersdorp Police Station. John Barnard made a full confession after evidence placed him at the scene of several murders, including the home of Glen McGregor. Ben: I did a 205 on everybody’s phones that was involved in the killings, and John Barnard was the only person that when they went to a crime scene, and he was with, he took his phone. So if you looked at their phones, they were still at 17 Cosanna Flats, but his phone was here. V/O: At 17 Cosanna Flats Ben found irrefutable evidence that this was the scene of the appointment murders. Ben: There was a wall unit here, there was this little piece of carpet here, and the bed was standing there. V/O: Noticing stains on the carpet, he arranged for the BlueStar forensic test. Ben: Even though the carpet was washed twice, we still found blood on the carpet, on the underfelt and on the cement, and that blood was Scholefield’s and Leroux’s. So it seems to me that Leroux and Scholefield were in a battle here, because Leroux’s blood was also found here. V/O: Leroux also told Ben about a false compartment he’d constructed in his bedroom at flat number 17. That’s where he stashed the gangs large firearms, The police recovered a variety of weapons, including a semi-automatic rifle, and a shotgun. But firearms were also cunningly concealed behind the building. Ben: They used fishing line, put it on the gutter. Then on that fishing line there was a blue rope, but you can’t see the blue rope. Then on that rope there was a bag, and in that bag was all the hand weapons that they hide between two walls. So, even if you walk past there, you look up you will not be able to see the fishing line because, you must look for it actually to see it. V/O: Within 3 weeks of Ben taking over the investigation, all the Krugersdorp Killers had been arrested. Ben: When I asked Leroux when would you stop killing people? And he told me straight in prison, they wouldn’t have stopped because it was easy money and they got away with so many murders already that they wouldn’t have stopped until they have been arrested. Link: From Day1the details of this trial have been shocking beyond belief. But just when you thought it couldn’t get any more dramatic, the Court was rocked by new evidence. After a 6-month recess, Marcel Steyn took the stand and delivered what can only be described as a bomb. Marcel: Not guilty on both Counts, Your Honour. V/O: Having originally pleaded Not Guilty to all charges, Marcel now admitted her involvement in the crimes, including all the murders. Marcel: Cecilia had said that it’s war. So, she said you know, in times of war things work differently and she used David as an example. She said that David killed a lot of people, sometimes even the wives and the children and the livestock because God instructed him to. And she said that God had instructed her that this is what we must do. V/O: Now 21, she was only 14 years-old when she watched her mother and Zak kill Pastor Reg Bendixen. Marcel: Then I saw then that he was already on the ground. Sharon: Yes? Marcel: And my mom was stabbing him. Sharon: Yes, what did you do then? Marcel: I froze. I just stared at them. I could not stop looking at them. V/O: She then described how she’d been taken to Zak’s house during the school holidays, to help her mother kill Mikaela Valentine. Marcel: I stood there and I was looking at my mother stab her, and I was thinking that you know if we go back to Cecilia an my mother tells her that I froze, that she is going to ridicule me, and say you know I am supposed to be the one with the psychopath demons, how could I freeze? So I went in and I had my own knife, and I stabbed her in her left side and then I just could not do more than that. So I told my mother my knife is blunt, you know it is not working, and she said it is okay, she is going to finish up now anyway, and I retreated to the door again and I waited for her to finish. V/O: Marcel also admitted to being present when Peter and Joan Meyer were killed in their home in November 2015. Ben: The father was laying here and the mother was laying here. It was just blood everywhere. Marcel: Zack just started stabbing them. I think he stabbed Joan Meyer first, and at that point Peter Meyer started reciting Psalm 23. And he started stabbing and then he moved back and forth between the two of them. Ben: You know, I took the cases over a long time after the killing, so I only saw the photos. but sawing the photos and listening to the people testifying, there’s a picture in my mind that is difficult to get out. Derek: You can’t get rid of it? Ben: No, you can’t get rid of it. V/O: The Meyers were killed while Marcel was writing matric, which she passed with 6 distinctions. Link: With all the sensational revelations of this trial, the brazen and dramatic killings, it’s easy to focus on the perpetrators. We forget that behind each victim is a family that has been completely devastated. V/O: Kezia McAlpine was 7 months pregnant when her husband Kevin didn’t return from his 6 o’ clock appointment. Kezia: And eventually someone said we found the car and there’s a body in the boot, and we’re not sure if it’s your husband or not? Derek: How did you feel right then? Kezia: I think I just immediately started praying and going please let it not be him. I'm sure it’s not him, it’s was just a mistake. It has to be somebody else. And then they asked if I could send them a picture of him so that they could identify whether it was him or not in the boot. And I remember at one point I just went and sort of hid behind the couch and thought if nobody can tell me, then it can’t be him. I think they were scared because I was pregnant, and what would happen if they did tell me that it was him. So they were waiting for the ambulance to get there, the paramedics, and I could hear on the phone, and you know when a phone call is rather loud, him saying to the man on the other side - it is him. V/O: Now the Manager of Cradle of Hope, Candice Ellison and her partner Jared Jackson were recovering addicts in 2015. They sold sweets and chips near Cosanna Flats, and they were befriended by Cecilia and the group. When Zak decided to fake his own death and claim millions in life insurance, it was Jarod who was strangled and burned in his place. Candice: Initially all I knew was that Jarod didn't come home and I tried to contact Celia and find out what's going on with Jarod, are Jarod and Zak okay? And when I eventually went to Cecilia's flat she told me no, that Jarod had not gone with Zak but that Zak had been in a car accident and was in a coma. And I asked where Jarod was, and she said she did not know. Jared left and walked away that night. V/O: Candice gave birth to their daughter just 3 weeks after Jarod disappeared, but only found out months later what had happened to him. Candice: That was one of the most traumatic moments, because I’d had months of self-doubt that Jared ran away. Did he commit suicide? Did he get scared, did he meet another woman? Was he wandering in the streets somewhere, had he been hurt? And at that moment all of that just came home and absolutely destroyed me. V/O: Lorna McGregor’s brother Glen was shot, strangled and placed in a bath of hot water after the group stole R6000 out of his bank account. Lorna: He must have still been alive. He wasn’t dead. He wasn’t dead…so I mean, how do you put someone through so much pain? It’s terrible, it’s absolutely terrible! Not even for just Glen, listening to Glen’s thing, but to sit and listen to each and – what they did to each and every family’s member. Marcel: l’m very sorry. I know that me testifying and telling the truth and admitting what I had done and how sorry I am does not bring them back. And I realized that it does not take the pain away and that you are going to walk with that for the rest of your life and I contributed to that. And all I can say is I’m sorry. I am really sorry. Link: Now that all three accused have been convicted, they await sentencing. But what is an appropriate sentence for Marcel who was only 14 when the first murders were committed? Will the State seek the maximum – 11 life sentences – or will Judge Francis be lenient? Lorna: Is there an actual sentence you can give them for what they’ve done - the hurt , the pain they’ve put us all through? There is no sentence actually, even if they had to get a hundred years. Is it going to take our pain away, is it going to give us that peace? No, it’s not. Kezia: I think I’ve come to realize that no matter what happens there, it doesn’t change things for me. It doesn’t bring Daniel’s dad back. It doesn’t bring my husband back. But I feel like they should probably never get out of prison. Candice: I know they’re going to get the sentence they deserve, and ultimately, the only appropriate sentence can be dished out by God. Ben: These people need to be punished on another level, because they’re evil. They’re evil. metadata.One Liner (Tonight on Carte Blanche...): The verdict in the year-long murder trial of the Krugersdorp Killers
metadata.Unique Selling Point: Exclusive interview with SAPS investigating officer, Captain Ben Booysen. Exclusive interview with Hannelie Scheepers, the step-mother who convinced Marcell Steyn to confess the truth. Exclusive interviews with the families of the victims. Crime scene photos
metadata.Summary: After a year in Court, the Krugersdorp Killers trial draws to a close. We summarise the crimes, families of victims detail how the nightmare unfolded through first hand accounts and crime scene photos. Captain Ben Booysen takes us through his investigation and reveals how he managed to crack the case and link the Appointment Murders to 7 previous murders.
metadata.Further information: In a stunning turnaround, Marcell Steyn took the stand after a 6-month break and confessed to her involvement in and knowledge of all the murders, the bomb throwing, the intimidation and the unlawful possession of arms and ammunition. She also implicated Cecilia Steyn, confirming that she was the leader of the Ministry and the mastermind behind all the crimes. Her stepmother had visited her in Prison over December and convinced her to tell the truth.
